limitations: Six deliberately selected questions are not a statistically representative campaign
CLI skips chat scope/injection classifiers and observational memory; web overhead is unmeasured
Private sample disables server response storage and caps output at 8192; production behavior may differ
Scope cases are conservatively treated as ordinary question costs here; their actual distribution is unmeasured
Terra noncached inputs are conservatively priced at the 25% cache-write ceiling
Cold normalization removes observed cached-input discounts; request/token volumes remain those of this sample
Judge costs retain prior assumptions; no paid judge was invoked and configured Anthropic access remains unresolved
Retries, timeouts, extra queries, model calibration, research, browser/memory acceptance and hosting are excluded
Trimming was diagnostic only. Full corpus cost after a parser repair requires reparse, identity/catalog reconciliation and exact shared-plan measurement
